# GoNoodle

> > GoNoodle is a comprehensive kids fitness, mindfulness, and active learning platform offering dance videos, movement activities, and social-emotional learning content for elementary classrooms.

GoNoodle provides teachers and families with engaging, curriculum-aligned videos and activities that combine physical exercise, mindfulness, and social-emotional development. The platform features popular content creators like Blazer Fresh and KIDZ BOP Kids, with multilingual support including Spanish-language options.

## Key Topics

- Elementary classroom activities
- Kids fitness and movement
- Dance videos
- Mindfulness and breathing exercises
- Social-emotional learning
- Indoor recess activities
- Blazer Fresh
- KIDZ BOP Kids
- The Mooderators
- Physical activity and coordination
- Guided dance routines
- Spanish-language content
- Sports education
- Google Classroom integration
- Inclusive wellness

## Dance & Movement Videos

- [GoNoodle I Can Do That](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/GYpNq2/i-can-do-that): Dance fitness video with Sloane Stephens & Blazer Fresh
- [GoNoodle Party In The USA](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/9Y7xpX/party-in-the-usa): Pop music dance video with NTV for classroom movement
- [GoNoodle Better When I'm Dancing](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/0YZpG2/better-when-im-dancing): Dance movement video promoting kids fitness & wellness
- [GoNoodle KIDZ BOP Kids: "KIDZ BOP Never Stop"](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/r26Br2/kidz-bop-kids-kidz-bop-never-stop): KIDZ BOP dance-along video for elementary classroom activity
- [GoNoodle KIDZ BOP Kids: "Life of the Party"](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/kYzKxX/life-of-the-party): KIDZ BOP party dance video with original music
- [GoNoodle Indoor Recess: Blazer Fresh 2.0 Edition](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/Y7ldZX/indoor-recess-blazer-fresh-2-dot-0-edition): Indoor recess dance party with Coach Terry & Blazer Fresh
- [GoNoodle Every Body HAPPY Together](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/72Ge8Y/every-body-happy-together): Inclusive mind-body wellness dance with Matt Maxey

## Sports & Fitness Activities

- [GoNoodle The Ball Is In Your Court](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/nYMvpX/the-ball-is-in-your-court): Tennis-themed exercise video with Blazer Fresh & sports education
- [GoNoodle Wildcard Activity Book](https://www.gonoodle.com/activities/aYyDdw/wildcard-activity-book): Tennis activity book by USTA Coaching for indoor recess
- [GoNoodle Strike A Pose](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/EY9EjY/strike-a-pose): Pose mimicry movement game from The Champiverse series
- [GoNoodle Cosmic Power-Up with Mario and Yoshi](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/XddxbX/cosmic-power-up-with-mario-and-yoshi): Super Mario Galaxy-inspired movement & coordination exercise

## Mindfulness & Social-Emotional Learning

- [GoNoodle The Mooderators: Angry](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/9Y7LpX/the-mooderators-angry): Social-emotional learning video on anger management
- [GoNoodle Rest Well](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/eYRk0X/rest-well): Mindfulness breathing exercise for rest & bedtime routine

## Spanish-Language Content

- [GoNoodle ¡Toma el día! (Take On The Day en español)](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/72GP4w/toma-el-dia): Spanish-language morning mindfulness & breathing exercise
- [GoNoodle Las Mooderators: Escanea con un plan](https://www.gonoodle.com/videos/XNzAaX/the-mooderators-scan-with-a-plan-en-espanol): Spanish body-scan mindfulness video for emotional awareness
